trials.claim: Widget lets you notify website visitors about latest developments
trials.claimQuote: A quick-to-setup widget that lets you notify your website visitors about your latest developments
trials.reasoning: Two buyer reviews confirm using the banner to keep website visitors informed and drive traffic to news updates. The single report of embed codes not working does not outweigh these consistent positive reports, and the general right to discontinue does not show the widget fails to notify.

exhibits.quote: The generated codes for embedding them on web pages do not work.
exhibits.argument: Direct buyer report that the embed code fails contradicts the claim the widget lets you notify visitors.

exhibits.quote: We reserve the right at any time to modify or discontinue the Service (or any part or content thereof) without notice at any time.
exhibits.argument: Vendor reserves unilateral right to discontinue the service without notice, undermining guaranteed notification functionality.

exhibits.quote: If you're looking for a straightforward way to keep your website visitors informed, Answerly Banner is a solid choice.
exhibits.argument: Reviewer confirms the widget's core purpose is notifying website visitors with up-to-date information.

exhibits.quote: I'm using it as an announcement banner widget to drive traffic to my news site on a daily basis.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms using the widget as an announcement banner to notify visitors.
